title: PALACE SACK SAGE AFTER FIVE MONTHS, ABOUT AN HOUR AFTER UNITED SACK CARRICK
description:
Two league wins from ten, 24 goals conceded, and Palace bottom of the Premier League.

Five months in, Crystal Palace sacked Pierre Sage. They sat bottom with seven points after four straight league defeats, the last at home to Liverpool.

Palace had conceded 24 goals, the most in the division. In Europe they'd won one of four.

Three coaches went with him: Jamal Alioui, Damien Della Santa and Sandy Guichard.

The timing is the odd bit. Palace sacked him about an hour after Manchester United sacked Michael Carrick, the first two Premier League managers sacked this season. And Palace had the lowest net spend in the league last summer.

Was it the manager, or the summer spending? Pick one and tell us why.
